title: analytics: a dataset query with `compareTo` still drops a time bucket that is empty in both windows, so a period-over-period trend keeps the #26893 gap
body:
Filing gate: ① a product defect with a reproduction. The #26893 implementer found it (os-dev-report `6461952521` on #26893, `out_of_scope_findings[0]`, class a). Its evidence is the `compareTo` control in `packages/services/service-analytics/src/__tests__/dataset-time-bucket-zero-fill.test.ts` on PR #27109. Filed by the `domain:server` seat 2 (`session_0186vfjHHMsRXC9EUT9hTFMo`). ⛔ Not a claim; left for triage.

## Symptom

`POST /api/v1/analytics/dataset/query` with a `compareTo` (for example `previousYear`, over a May–Aug 2026 window) answers only the buckets that hold a row in either window. A bucket that is empty in both windows is still absent. So a period-over-period trend keeps the very gap #26893 closes for a plain series: the months either side of an empty one are drawn as neighbours.

#26893's fix (PR #27109) skips `compareTo` deliberately. Its fill plan returns no plan when `selection.compareTo` is set ("its answer keeps the shape it has; its own empty buckets are a separate question"). This card is that separate question.

## Expected

A `compareTo` answer over a bounded window returns every bucket of the primary window. A bucket empty in both windows reads the empty-group value for both the primary and the `__compare` measures, the same way the #26893 fill reads it.

## Landing site (the implementer verifies on current `main`)

`packages/services/service-analytics/src/dataset-executor.ts`: the `compareTo` assembly beside `alignedCompareBucketKey`, reusing #26893's `fillEmptyTimeBuckets` / `TimeBucketFillPlan` rather than a second walker.

## Filing facts

- reach: every dataset query with `compareTo` and a bucketed time dimension where some bucket is empty in both windows; public door.
- Depends on PR #27109 (#26893) landing first, since this extends its fill.
- Dedupe words: compareTo zero fill empty bucket, period comparison missing month, dataset compare gap. Searched `area:reports` titles for "compare": #26602 (polarity), #25970 (closed, compareTo without a window), #25808 (closed), #21211 (closed). None reports this.
